items.label: Complete Set
items.value: The package includes 6 pcs inflatable bean bag chairs and an electric pump for effortless inflation and deflation in just minutes, getting your space ready for guests instantly. As with all blow up chairs, slight air loss over time is normal; quick top-ups restore firmness anytime.

items.label: Sturdy and Soft
items.value: Crafted from flocked PVC, this inflatable couch is soft to the touch yet sturdy enough to support up to 160 lbs, offering a perfect blend of comfort and durability for daily use.

items.label: Ultra-Portable and Compact
items.value: Each blow up couch seat measures 38.5 × 21.6 × 11 in when inflated; but folds down to a compact size for easy storage or travel, making it an ideal seating solution for dorm rooms, camping, and small apartments.

items.label: Adjustable Firmness On-Demand
items.value: The inflatable chair allows you to easily set your preferred firmness with the included electric pump; simply perform quick air top-ups as needed to maintain perfect comfort anytime.

items.label: Versatile for Any Occasion
items.value: This inflatable lazy sofa is incredibly versatile, perfect as a floor sofa for gaming, a camping chair, or for outdoor movie nights, providing fun and practical seating anywhere.

items.label: Item Firmness Description
items.value: Adjustable: Balanced between firm and soft, adjustable to personal preference.
